en.title: Scan Once. Sync to Vault & Market.
en.caption:
Fresh pull? List it in under 60 seconds.

1. Point your camera to identify EN, JP, or ID printings
2. Save raw singles and graded slabs into your Digital Vault
3. Publish to VivrePlay Market at fixed price or live auction

No manual set-code typing. Start at https://vivreplay.com/vault

id.title: Scan Sekali. Masuk Vault & Siap Jual.
id.caption:
Baru dapat pull bagus? Pasang listing kurang dari 60 detik.

1. Arahkan kamera untuk kenali cetakan EN, JP, atau ID
2. Simpan kartu raw dan graded slab ke Vault Koleksi
3. Jual di VivrePlay Market dengan harga pas atau lelang live

Tanpa ketik kode set manual. Coba di https://vivreplay.com/id/vault
